stops.detail: The Weltenburg Enge, also known as the Danube Breakthrough near Weltenburg, is an approximately 5.5 km long narrowing point of the Danube Valley between Kelheim and the Weltenburg Monastery. The geotope is located along the Danube in the Lower Bavarian district of Kelheim and in the southern Frankenalb.
